The Zoho One mobile app provides a centralized admin console for admins to manage their whole business on the go, and an app launcher for employees to access all their work apps with a single click.

Features:
- User management: Admins can add users and assign apps, roles, and groups to those users, right from their mobile phones.
- Notifications: Admins get notified in real-time when users request password resets or access to new apps.
- Launcher: Your employees can request, install, and launch all their work apps from the One Launcher.
- Search: Your employees can search and access anything across all of Zoho One without having to open multiple apps.
